look_here_first: Think tall wetland obedient-plant: a rhizomatous perennial often over 1 m tall, with opposite narrow leaves and a long spike of pink-purple bilabiate flowers in saturated stream-edge or drainage habitat.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis — extant Lady Bird Lake / Austin populations documented by USFWS and recent survey work. Bexar — historical native Texas record documented in USGS/TPWD conservation literature. Gillespie — historical native record documented in Texas conservation literature, now considered extirpated.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Historical/extirpated records may establish native county occurrence; cultivated records do not.

best_field_traits: elongated terminal spike of pink-purple bilabiate flowers
flowers borne in repeated verticillaster-like clusters
streambank, ditch, spring, river-edge and saturated sediment habitat
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with the broad Physostegia virginiana complex, P. correllii is a rare southern wetland specialist with strong stream-edge affiliation and a tall, rhizomatous habit.
